summary: DROP CANDIDATE: the Chippewa NF no longer lists Tamarack Point anywhere on its site (not in the 2026 developed-campground fee/season table, which names every Deer River District campground, nor in the forest's campground list); its old FS page now redirects to the forest home; RIDB keeps only a non-reservable stub; camper reports call it padlocked (2021) and unmaintained with overgrown roads (Aug 2025). No result groups written.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (abandoned / no longer an FS campground): the forest's 2026 table 'Deer River District | 218-246-2123' lists Cut Foot Horse Camp, Deer Lake North, Deer Lake South, East Seely Bay, Mosomo Point, Onegume, Williams Narrows, Clubhouse Lake and North Star, and no Tamarack Point; the Camping and Cabins list ('Showing: 1 - 10 of 20 results', both pages read) and the Deer River Area pages do not name it either. The FS page RIDB links (recid=26742) redirects to the forest's recreation home. Condition, from The Dyrt (aggregator, dated camper reports): Aug. 31, 2025 'Perhaps this was a Chippewa national Forest campground in the past, but it has not been upkeep at all. It would be good for dispersed camping but none of the sites are cleared, and the roads are overgrown.'; Oct. 27, 2021 'Another padlocked campground.' No official closure notice was found. If kept instead, it would want status temporarily_closed with a note, and the phone 218-335-8600 (Supervisor's Office) should become the Deer River District 218-246-2123.

LAND STATUS (context only, not established): Campflare files it under 'Leech Lake Reservation > Cass County'; the 2024 Leech Lake Band of Ojibwe Reservation Restoration Act transfer (FS project 64623, ~11,760 acres in Cass County) was checked and does not name parcels on its page, so whether Tamarack Point went into trust is unknown.

WATERFRONT lakeview: not assessed further; on 2025 and 2013 leaf-off imagery the pin sits ~20-40 m inside the wooded Winnibigoshish shore with only a few spur roads visible and no recognisable 31-site loop, consistent with an overgrown campground.
WEBSITE https://www.recreation.gov/camping/poi/249536 is a POI stub with no booking or details; the FS page is gone. No replacement official page exists.
